name: PolicySet
description: PolicySet is a logical grouping of ACM Policies in the same namespace. A PolicySet can be bound to a Placement or PlacementRule to apply a shared placement strategy to all included policies. Its status reflects the overall compliance across all policies.
usageHint: Use PolicySet to apply the same placement and binding configuration to a group of related policies. It simplifies management and compliance reporting.

spec.description: string (optional, a human-readable summary of the policy set)
PCI compliance policies for all production clusters
